reason: Apply the round-3 review's one genuine in-scope P2 for frontend-shell-login (delegate does not convey autoreview findings to Codex): (quality/P2, t8-c3) login-form verify() catch currently shows the invalid-code copy for EVERY failure; branch it so only a confirmed ApiError 401 (the bad/expired code) shows INVALID_CODE, while a 5xx/network/malformed failure shows a generic 'We couldn't verify the code. Try again.' (parallel to the existing send-error copy) — mirrors the SessionGuard 401-only fix. Adds a test asserting 401->invalid-code and non-401->generic. 2 files: login-form.tsx, login-form.test.tsx. The other three round-3 P2s are ledgered, not fixed: per-POST CSRF re-read is the contract's deliberate defense-in-depth (security lens = 10/approve), the ack live-region announcement is an a11y polish whose correct fix risks the design layout/test timing late, and the em-dash copy is the proven spec-false-positive (D-0015).
